BST260 Final Project Proposal

Weijie Li

2026-11-18

Source: vignettes/proposal.qmd

To: BST260 Teaching Team, Fall 2026

I will write two vignettes addressing analysis tasks, using the NHANES and the CDC waterborne dataset.

Analysis 1

Research question

I want to examine the association between BMI and systolic blood pressure among adults by using the NHANES dataset.

Unit of analysis and population

The unit of analysis is individual. The study population is adult age>=20 in the NHANES dataset.

Exposure variable(s)

The exposure here is BMI in kg/m^2, a continuous numeric variable. I will exclude the missing value from my analysis.

Outcome variable

The outcome is average systolic blood pressure in mm hg, also a continous variable. In NHANES, it marked as BPSysAve.

Confounders

The potential confounders is age and sex. They may influence the BMI and systolic blood pressure.

Analysis 2

Research question

I want to examine the association between outbreak setting and the number of illnesses per outbreak by using the CDC waterborne dataset.

Unit of analysis and population

Unit of analysis is one reported outbreak Population is reported foodborne outbreaks in the CDC waterborne dataset.

Exposure variable(s)

Eposure variable is outbreak setting. I will code it as a categorical variable with four levels: restaurant, private residence, other setting and multiple settings. I will exclude the missing value.

Outcome variable

The outcome will be the reported number of illnesses per outbreak, as a quantitative count outcome.

Confounders

Potential confounders i may include are year, season, and geographic region based on my subject-matter reasoning.
